upstream.verdict: H1 (impairment +3.8% 3/3 years positive, not single-name driven; price_up -2.7% 3/3 negative but top1 concentration 27.8%; epidemic_shock 2020-only, not adopted)

engine.mode: non-zones (v1.3 semantics; zones argument never passed)

derived_runner_allowed_changes: engine pin (v1.3 84a2443a -> workspace v1.4.1 a01cb29c; precedent: attribution run runner_attrib.py)

event_flag.window_rule: signal_date >= ann_date and trading_days_between(ann_date, signal_date) in [0, 60]; calendar = shared r16 market_calendar
event_flag.multi_event_rule: same class -> nearest (max ann_date); impairment vs price_up conflict -> later announcement wins (max ann_date); equal ann_date -> STOP and report count
event_flag.rank_basis: flags are attached to composite rows only (arm A/B modify composite values; arm C ranks z_event over the same eligible set as the 17 factors)

F3R4-A.b_rule: median over signal months of the F3-EW composite cross-sectional std

F3R4-C.z_event: z_event = (rank_pct - 0.5) * (+1) over the eligible set; 0/+1/-1 event column; a month with no flag has z_event null (degenerate column), so C equals the 17-factor composite there

adjudication.line: net CAGR >= baseline + 0.003 AND max_drawdown >= baseline - 0.01

sensitivity.role: disclosure only; never changes the adjudication

seams.TF-S1: B arm suppression is a parquet-level equivalent of a veto; if every candidate were suppressed the name could still be seated (expected probability ~0, disclosed)
seams.TF-S2: derived runner diff vs F3R3 original limited to composite input path + output prefix (+ engine pin, precedent documented); diff recorded in the manifest
seams.TF-S3: b value, per-month std and z_event distribution registered for independent recomputation
seams.TF-S4: event conflict rule executed mechanically; conflict counts disclosed
